_comment: Copy this file next to agent.py on EACH lab PC and edit the values below for that machine.
_secret_comment: Must exactly match PC_AGENT_SHARED_SECRET in the server's compulab/settings.py
_port_comment: Must match PC_AGENT_PORT in the server's settings.py
_server_url_comment: Base URL of the CompuLab Django server, used by the on-screen login form. For real lab PCs, this is the server's LAN address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000
_college_name_comment: Shown in the top-left header of the lock screen, next to the college seal.
college_subtitle: A Smart Computer Laboratory Management System
_college_subtitle_comment: Small line under the college name in the top-left header.
_pc_name_comment: FALLBACK ONLY. On every lock, the agent asks the CompuLab server which pc_id is actually assigned to this PC in the admin panel (Manage PCs -> Add/Edit) and shows that instead, so this value and the admin panel can never drift out of sync. This is only shown for the brief moment before the server answers, or if it can't be reached at all (e.g. no network yet, or this PC has no IP address on file in the admin panel).
_lab_name_comment: FALLBACK ONLY, same as pc_name above — the agent shows the server's real lab_name for this PC once it responds. Shown in the LABORATORY column of the status row on the lock screen.
_lock_title_comment: Optional full override for the big lock-screen heading. Leave blank ('') to use the default 'ACCESS REQUIRED' heading. Only set this if you want custom text instead.
lock_subtitle: Please enter your Student ID and Reservation Code to access and use this computer.
_activity_report_interval_seconds_commen: How often (seconds) the agent samples the active/foreground window's title bar text and reports it to the server, while the PC is unlocked. Set to 0 to disable this reporting entirely.
